name: Muzan ~Ketsuniku no Ikenie~
source:
Fifteen women have been gathered for different reasons in the residence of the famous mistress Elizabeth. However Elizabeth has lured them for no other purpose than sacrifice them in a ritual to gain immortality.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
十五名女子因各自不同的理由聚集在著名女主人伊丽莎白的宅邸。然而，伊丽莎白将她们诱骗至此别无他图，只是为了把她们献作祭品，通过仪式获得永生。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
